people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.
translations.bsb: “Babylon must fall on account of the slain of Israel, just as the slain of all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.
translations.kjv: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
translations.asv: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the land.
